paragraphs.source_en: In the third month of Tenshō 9, when Takatenjin Castle fell, Katsuyori was confronting Hōjō Ujimasa's thirty-thousand-strong army, which had advanced to Mishima. Unable either to advance or retreat, he found himself in a grave predicament.

units.source_zh: 天正九年三月，高天神城陷落之时，胜赖正在和出兵三岛的北条氏政的三万大军对峙，欲进不能，欲退不行，十分为难。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天正九年三月，高天神城陷落之时，胜赖正在和出兵三岛的北条氏政的三万大军对峙，欲进不能，欲退不行，十分为难。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsuyori had intended to press on and fight a decisive battle against the Hōjō, but Takeda Samanosuke Nobutoyo and Nagasaka Chōkan strongly remonstrated with him—indeed, they opposed him outright. In the end, he was forced to leave Kōsaka Gengorō to hold Numazu against the enemies at Kōkokuji and Tokura, while he himself withdrew his entire force.

units.source_en: Katsuyori had intended to press on and fight a decisive battle against the Hōjō, but Takeda Samanosuke Nobutoyo and Nagasaka Chōkan strongly remonstrated with him—indeed, they opposed him outright.
units.source_zh: 胜赖本想继续进军，与北条氏展开决战，可是遭到了武田左马助信丰和长坂钓闲的强谏，不，不如说强烈反对。

units.source_en: In the end, he was forced to leave Kōsaka Gengorō to hold Numazu against the enemies at Kōkokuji and Tokura, while he himself withdrew his entire force.
units.source_zh: 结果，他不得不让高坂源五郎守沼津，防卫兴国寺和户仓等地之敌，自己则全线退兵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜赖本想继续进军，与北条氏展开决战，可是遭到了武田左马助信丰和长坂钓闲的强谏，不，不如说强烈反对。结果，他不得不让高坂源五郎守沼津，防卫兴国寺和户仓等地之敌，自己则全线退兵。

paragraphs.source_en: At the same time, Anayama Nyūdō Baisetsu of Suruga repeatedly urged him, “Our only course now is to suspend all hostilities and restore our strength...”

units.source_en: At the same time, Anayama Nyūdō Baisetsu of Suruga repeatedly urged him, “Our only course now is to suspend all hostilities and restore our strength...”
units.source_zh: 此时，骏河的穴山入道梅雪也在频频进言：“唯今之计，应该全面停战，休养生息……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，骏河的穴山入道梅雪也在频频进言：“唯今之计，应该全面停战，休养生息……”

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, Takatenjin Castle fell, and in Tenshō 9, following his defeat at Nagashino, Katsuyori entered the most anxious year of his life.

units.source_en: Before long, Takatenjin Castle fell, and in Tenshō 9, following his defeat at Nagashino, Katsuyori entered the most anxious year of his life.

paragraphs.source_zh: 结果，高天神城未几失陷，胜赖在天正九年，继长筱战败之后又迎来了他一生中最焦虑的一年。

paragraphs.source_en: Yet at the year's end, as Kōfu welcomed the New Year of Tenshō 10, Katsuyori remained full of ambition. He would rest his troops through the winter, then, when spring brought warmth and blossoms, join forces with Uesugi Kagekatsu of Echigo and enlist Ishiyama Honganji to strike a crushing blow against the enemies he hated.

units.source_en: Yet at the year's end, as Kōfu welcomed the New Year of Tenshō 10, Katsuyori remained full of ambition.

paragraphs.source_zh: 但是，在是年年底，当甲府迎来天正十年新春之际，胜赖仍然踌躇满志。冬天歇兵，等到春暖花开，再联合越后的上杉景胜，邀石山本愿寺，给他痛恨的敌人以狠狠的打击。

paragraphs.source_en: Naturally, the powers opposed to him were making calculations of their own. What they feared most was that Katsuyori would retreat into the natural fastness of Kai, never emerge again, and leisurely rebuild his strength.

units.source_en: Naturally, the powers opposed to him were making calculations of their own.

paragraphs.source_zh: 当然，他的敌对几方也在进行着同样的合计。敌人担心的，正是胜赖撤回天险甲州后再也不出来，悠悠地休养生息。

paragraphs.source_en: Ever since the Takeda clan's distant ancestor Minamoto no Yoshimitsu, the family had continued to grow and prosper in this land precisely because no one regarded them as its overlords. Thus they had gradually amassed strength and laid deep foundations in the country.

paragraphs.source_en: In the second month of Tenshō 10, Katsuyori received important intelligence: Kiso Samanokami Yoshimasa of Kiso-Fukushima Castle had gone over to the Oda clan.
